text:
maya: Quick sync — we're starting a small canary for the SDK-driven feature gate on new routing. Targeting 5% web + 5% iOS, only for clients >= 1.8.0. Need to confirm header format, server guardrails, and the kill-switch before we flip.
kevin: SG. Proposed header: `X-RD-FF: new_routing_v2=on;client=1.8.0`. Keep it short so mobile UDPs don't choke. Server should treat unknown flags as off.
tiago: For older clients (<1.8) we should default to legacy routing server-side. Also add a server-side mapping so we can opt users into canary without client change.
maya: Agreed. Two paths: header-based (preferred) + server fallback mapping for older clients. Add explicit version check in SDK: only send header when `clientVersion >= 1.8.0`.
julie: I'll open PRs: sdk-js #4823 and server #4824. Can someone grab review for the server change? cc @kevin
kevin: I can review server PR later today. Quick checklist: (1) header parsing tolerant of whitespace, (2) max header length 512, (3) ignore unknown keys, (4) log flag_eval events.
maya: Nice checklist. For logging/telemetry we want these events: `feature_flag_exposure`, `flag_evaluated`, `flag_fallback_reason`. tag with `client_version`, `route`, `user_segment`.
tiago: Also ensure metrics allow splitting by canary cohort. We need a dashboard showing errors, latency p50/p99 for canary vs control within first 2h. If latency regresses >15% auto-fallback.
julie: Adding automated guardrail: server config `feature_gates.auto_revert_on_latency_pct=15` and `feature_gates.observed_window_minutes=120`. Ops can toggle kill-switch: `feature_gates.kill_switches.new_routing_v2=true` to disable immediately.
maya: SDK change (js/ios): only attach header when flag is enabled in local SDK config and clientVersion >= 1.8. Example fetch snippet: ```js
// sdk: attach flag header
fetch('/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'X-RD-FF': 'new_routing_v2=on'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify(payload)
})
```
kevin: For mobile we should send minimal header: `X-RD-FF: nr2=1` (nr2 = new_routing_v2) to save bytes. Server will map aliases. Add mapping table in server config.
tiago: Good idea. Also add a server-side fallback_reason enum: `client_too_old`, `guardrail_triggered`, `manual_kill`. Put that into logs for triage.
maya: Who's owning the canary rollout tonight (ETA 9pm PST)? I can flip web canary if ops is ready. julie you do mobile?
julie: I can take mobile canary. I'll coordinate with QA for smoke tests. ops-bot: Canary deployment initiated for cohort "canary-2024-04-xx" in us-west-2, 5% traffic. Watch `#incidents` if anything spikes.
kevin: Quick note for backward compatibility: schema for `X-RD-FF` must remain stable. Use `key=value;key2=val2` and percent encoded values if needed. No JSON in header.
maya: Final action items: (1) julie: wire telemetry and PRs, (2) kevin: review server PR + header parsing, (3) tiago: dashboards + auto-revert rule, (4) maya: flip web canary at 9pm PST if ops green. If anyone else wants to join the rollout window ping here. :thumbsup:
